email_templates.name: Inbound Day-1 Curiosity
email_templates.subject: Curious About Your [Event Type]
email_templates.body:
Hi [Name],

I noticed you recently reached out to us about catering for your [event type] on [date].

What's the most important detail you're focusing on right now?

email_templates.name: Inbound Day-2 Curiosity
email_templates.subject: [First Name]
email_templates.body:
Hi [Name],

It's Andre again from Comeketo Catering.

I was thinking about your [event type], and I'm curious about [specific thing].

When would be a good time for a quick chat?

email_templates.name: Inbound Day-4 Dream Question
email_templates.subject: RE: [Event Type]
email_templates.body:
Quick question about your [event type]:

What's one thing you've always dreamed of including, but weren't sure how to pull off?

email_templates.name: Quote Follow-Up Direct
email_templates.subject: [First Name]
email_templates.body: Please let me know if there is anything specific holding you back from moving forward, or if you need any adjustments to the quote.

email_templates.name: Quote Follow-Up Soft-Confused
email_templates.subject: Quote
email_templates.body:
[First Name],

I get it, this catering stuff can be tough, and I wanted to see what questions you have.

When's the best time to call?

sms_templates.name: Day-1 Inbound
sms_templates.body: Hey [Name], it's Andre from Comeketo Catering. I just left you a voicemail but thought text might be easier. I have a few ideas for your [event type]. What's a good time today for a quick chat?

sms_templates.name: Day-2 Inbound
sms_templates.body: Hey [Name], it's Andre again. I missed you but left a voicemail. I'm looking forward to brainstorming ideas for your [event type]. I'll try again on [day/time].

sms_templates.name: Day-5 Finisher
sms_templates.body: Have you given up on catering your [event type]?

sms_templates.name: Tasting Confirmation
sms_templates.body: Hi [Customer Name], this is Andre from Comeketo Catering. Your tasting appointment is confirmed for [Date] at [Time]. Please check your email for details.

sms_templates.name: No-Show Concern
sms_templates.body: Hey [First Name], I missed you at the [tasting/appointment] today. I hope everything is okay. Give me a call so we can see when to reschedule.

sms_templates.name: No-Show Sharper
sms_templates.body: Hey [First Name], I missed you at the [tasting/appointment] today. Have you given up on catering?

sms_templates.name: Quote Revisit
sms_templates.body: Can we revisit the quote for your event?

sms_templates.name: Quote Hang-Up
sms_templates.body: What's holding you back from deciding on catering?

post_tasting_day1.name: Post-Tasting Day 1
post_tasting_day1.script:
Hi [Name], this is Andre from Comeketo Catering. I'm excited to hear about your tasting yesterday. How did you like the food and our service?

[PAUSE FOR RESPONSE]

I'm glad to hear that! What do you feel would be a good next step?

[PAUSE FOR RESPONSE]

That sounds great. We'd love to be a part of your [event]. When would you like to secure the catering service?

deposit_close.name: Deposit Assumptive Close
deposit_close.script:
Based on everything we've discussed, and the quote provided, would it be a bad idea to lock in Comeketo Catering for your event?

[WAIT FOR ANSWER]

That's wonderful to hear! I'll go ahead and get everything set up. To finalize, we'll need a deposit to reserve your date. Can we take care of that now?

deposit_hesitation.name: Deposit Hesitation Handler
deposit_hesitation.script: I completely understand. The deposit simply secures your date on our calendar - we're booking out almost 2 years in advance. It's fully refundable if anything changes after the tasting. What concerns do you have about moving forward today?

secret_weapon.name: Secret Weapon (Stakeholder)
secret_weapon.script: And regarding your [partner], is this something you 2 talked about before, or are we on a secret mission here? {ha, ha}

three_way_offer.name: Three-Way Call Offer
three_way_offer.script: Here's what I'd suggest: Let's schedule a quick 15-minute call with you, [partner], and me. I'll walk through the menu, pricing, and answer any questions directly. That way [partner] gets the full picture and you can make the decision together. How does [day/time] work for both of you?

quote_follow_up.name: Quote Follow-Up Call
quote_follow_up.script:
Hi [First Name], this is Andre from Comeketo Catering. I noticed you received a quote from us for your event but haven't accepted it yet. I wanted to follow up and see what the hang-up is.

Can you tell me what questions you have about our quote?

urgency_scarcity.name: Urgency + Scarcity Close
urgency_scarcity.script: I also wanted to mention that we have limited availability around your event date, and I'd hate for you to miss out on securing your spot. By confirming today, we can ensure everything is perfectly planned for your special day.
